items.title: ProFTPD’s SQL Injection Vulnerability Enables Remote Code Execution Attacks
items.description: A critical SQL injection vulnerability in ProFTPD, one of the Internet’s most widely deployed FTP servers. Tracked as CVE-2026-42167, this flaw carries a CVSS severity score of 8.1 and affects the mod_sql extension. Depending on how the server is configured, attackers can exploit this bug to bypass authentication, elevate their privileges, or achieve remote code execution (RCE). ProFTPD […] The…

items.title: Malicious npm Package Brand-Squats TanStack Exfiltrate Developer Secrets
items.description: A fake npm package has been caught silently stealing sensitive developer credentials by impersonating the widely trusted TanStack library. The package, published under the unscoped name “tanstack” on the npm registry, tricked developers into installing it instead of the legitimate “@tanstack/*” packages. Once installed, it ran hidden scripts that sent environment variable files straight to […]…

items.title: SonicWall SonicOS Vulnerabilities Allow Attackers to Bypass Access Controls and Crash Firewall
items.description: SonicWall has released a security advisory addressing three vulnerabilities in its SonicOS software. Discovered by the Advanced Research Team at CrowdStrike, these flaws could allow attackers to bypass access controls, reach restricted services, or cause a denial-of-service condition by crashing the firewall. items.title: Cursor AI Extension Access Developer Tokens Leads to Full Credential Compromise
items.description: A high-severity access-control vulnerability (CVSS 8.2) in Cursor, a widely used AI-powered coding environment. The flaw uncovered by LayerX has allowed any installed extension to access a developer’s API keys and session tokens secretly.
